name: Eshref Ruya
description: As a child, Eşref fell in love from afar with a girl he called “Rüya” and spent years searching for her, only to become a powerful mafia figure along the way. Meanwhile, Nisan, an idealistic musician, finds herself in grave danger after performing at a wedding held at Eşref’s hotel. Eşref falls for Nisan, unaware that she is both the long-lost Rüya he has been chasing for years and a police informant. Trapped in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles, Eşref is forced into a brutal reckoning—both with his criminal empire and his own emotions.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Eşref Rüya tells the story of a young man who is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know. Çağatay Ulusoy plays the character Eşref, who is reckless, has everything but is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know, while Demet Özdemir plays Nisan, the young musician who makes Eşref's heart skip a beat.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Nisan, who understands that she is in great danger once again with this incident, looks for ways to escape Çiğdem's games. Eşref cannot help but be carried away by feelings that he is unfamiliar with whenever he comes face to face with Nisan. Nisan's getting closer to Eşref causes alarm bells to ring for both of them. On the other hand, a great surprise awaits İzzet, who is drunk with victory. Eşref, who is preparing to make his enemies experience hell, will also face his new rival on the security front.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After İzzet’s death, Eşref now faces an even greater enemy. Horrified by everything that’s happened, Nisan prepares to make bold moves beyond her limits in order to finally end the game. Meanwhile, with his plans progressing as intended, Kadir is willing to betray the Yetimler to eliminate Eşref from the picture. On the law enforcement side, Serdar investigates the murder at the hotel and comes face to face with Eşref and the tribe. This tense confrontation—where everything could fall apart at any moment—sets the stage for an impending major conflict. Though Nisan plans to throw Eşref into the fire to save herself, seeing a different side of him pushes her into an unexpected dilemma. Her growing closeness with Eşref is about to land her in serious trouble.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Nimet’s abduction of Nisan and Afra signals that the war between the Yetimler and the tribe is far from over. Despite Serdar’s warnings, Eşref and Nusret continue to make moves that only fuel the fire of revenge between them. Kadir does everything he can to turn the Yetimler against Eşref. Meanwhile, his unexpected encounter with Nisan sparks unfamiliar emotions in Kadir’s heart. Eşref’s bold move to rescue Afra catches Nisan off guard. Now caught in a deep moral dilemma, will Nisan be willing to stain her hands with blood—if it means saving her sister’s life?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Kadir's appearance as a rival in his deepening relationship with Nisan upsets Eşref's balance.  Meanwhile, when Nisan's closeness to Eşref draws the attention of the Gürdals, Nisan faces the risk of being exposed. While Eşref is convinced to end his feud with Nusret, a surprise development leads him to burn all ships. Eşref's final move will not only cause him to throw himself into the fire, but also his loved ones. Nisan will make a move that will shake Eşref's heart in order to prevent her secrets from being revealed.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Nisan’s kiss leaves a deep emotional impact between her and Eşref. Witnessing everything from afar, Çiğdem is devastated. After Nusret’s treacherous attack harms his loved ones, Eşref is consumed by guilt. Unaware of the new trap being set for him, he begins to move forward with plans for revenge. Meanwhile, Nisan still faces the risk of being exposed and will do whatever it takes to retrieve the file. When Çiğdem finall

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler. Kadir, who is doing everything he can to prevent Eşref from coming to power, has started to get closer to Nisan. Will Kadir, who is burning with love and lust for power, be able to risk betraying Eşref, who he promised to always stand by his side? Eşref, who agreed to confront Nusret Ağa at the point where the Orphans are in danger, will cause the balances to change again with a surprise move that will have an impact in the underworld.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: While Eşref tries to protect Nisan on one hand, he also tries to find the identity of the person who betrayed her. While Eşref's absence causes the team to raise the alarm, Kadir, who prepared the plot, secretly follows the events. Çiğdem enters a big impasse with the move she made against Atıf. She is ready to take big risks to continue her game. While suspicions on Kadir increase, she will do her best to hide her betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Eşref sees with his own eyes that the traitor is Kadir and begins to meticulously plan his next move. Kadir feels that the tension between him and Eşref is increasing and looks for ways to get out of the situation he is in. As Nisan and Eşref continue their turbulent relationship, it will become increasingly difficult to resist the attraction between them. When weapons are drawn against betrayal, those who want to survive will have to act quickly.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Eşref kills Nusret, sending a strong warning to all his enemies. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Kadir senses that his mask is about to fall. When the time comes to confront Eşref, he understands it’s his last chance to set things right. Nisan is ready to confess, but she knows that once she takes that path, there’s no turning back. To get rid of Çiğdem, she must play her cards carefully and choose her words wisely. Meanwhile, Çiğdem’s obsession with Eşref reaches its peak, and she prepares to upend everything. With no tolerance left for betrayal, Eşref will make an unexpected move that will drastically alter his relationship with Nisan.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Although Nisan knows that there is no room for love in Eşref's dangerous world, she cannot help but dream of a future with Eşref. Eşref, on the other hand, is in shock at feeling such intense feelings for someone for the first time since Rüya. While the ceremony to be held for Eşref's ascension to power is on the agenda of the orphans, Kadir is in danger of being exposed at any moment. Helpless, Kadir will have to take refuge in Çiğdem's insidious plans. Eşref, who is in a great dilemma between his position in the underworld and his relationship with Nisan, will encounter an unexpected development that will turn his decisions upside down.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Kadir, blinded by his ambition for leadership, tries every way to seize control and is determined to crush everyone in his path. His collaboration with Çiğdem drags Nisan and Eşref into a dangerous conflict. In this great struggle where everything is turned upside down, Eşref fights with all his might to protect his loved ones. Eşref will face his nightmare while waiting to be reunited with his dream.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Eşref continues to intimidate his enemies with the sentence he's enacted in prison, while Nisan rapidly climbs the ladder of fame. Kadir, driven by his lust for power, plots moves to force the Yetimler to deviate from their principles, while his new partnership puts him in the middle of an unexpected situation.  When a mysterious figure emerges from the shadows of Nisan's past, they ignite a war that will shake their lives, forcing their love to face its greatest test yet.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Eşref has been released from prison and is now a free man; however, this time it is Nisan who is imprisoned with the grief of losing her sister. Even though Eşref tries to be by Nisan’s side during this most painful period of her life, the closeness that these two have with each other continues to be a threat to those around them. Following Afra’s shocking death, Dinçer puts his plan of revenge into place, as he continues to act ruthlessly while protecting his secrecy. Following the confrontation he had with Eşref, Kadir will continue his dirty games to protect his power, as he seeks a way to neutralize Eşref. As Nisan is trying to deal with the pain in her heart, she does not stop searching for clues regarding Afra’s mysterious death.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Taylan's final pointer to Eşref makes him a direct suspect. While Nisan doesn't want to suspect Eşref, she begins to secretly question what's happening. Dinçer is determined to take his plan one step further to drive a wedge between Nisan and Eşref. Meanwhile, Gürdal's disappearance creates growing anxiety within the team. Kadir plans to use Gürdal to corner Eşref. Eşref must contend with suspicions directed at him while trying to protect his loved ones.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Eşref, who took great risks to save Gürdal from Kadir, now becomes the target of the Russian mafia. Irmak, on the other hand, is ready to risk her life to learn Gürdal's whereabouts. Nisan, further confused by Dinçer's manipulations, begins to believe that Eşref may be responsible for Afra's death. Eşref, along with the team, tries to find Gürdal while simultaneously investigating the source of the slander against her. While Nisan tirelessly strives to find those responsible for her brother's murder, Eşref is willing to risk everything to clear her name and save Gürdal.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Eşref once again faces the risk of imprisonment. Çiğdem manages to destroy the records at the cost of her own life, but this further fuels prosecutor Selma's suspicions. Kadir, tricked by Eşref, resorts to new methods to maintain his power and reputation. As Nisan and Eşref become more attached than ever, Dinçer prepares to take his plans a step further to distance Nisan from Eşref. With Hıdır's support, Eşref pursues the mysterious figure who has been bothering him.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Dinçer’s fall down the stairs creates a new threat for Eşref, while Nisan is determined to do whatever it takes to protect him. Eşref is willing to go to any lengths to uncover the person who has been plotting against him. Meanwhile, Kadir, eager to secure his position, takes dangerous steps to expand his illegal operation. As Eşref follows the trail of the phantom pursuing him, he comes face to face with Çiğdem. Just when he believes he’s finally reunited with Nisan, he remains unaware that completely new obstacles await him.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Dinçer, having fallen into Eşref’s trap, desperately tries to calculate his next move. But just moments before Eşref comes face to face with his secret admirer, an explosion in the hangar shatters everyone’s plans. As Kadir searches for a new base of operations, Eşref realizes it’s time to put an end to his rival’s growing influence. With a bold move that publicly tarnishes Kadir’s reputation, Eşref also finds himself facing new enemies in his mission to rid the market of illegal substances. Meanwhile, Nisan, whose new music video has everyone talking, becomes increasingly suspicious of Dinçer and is determined to uncover the truth, no matter where it leads.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: In the midst of a deadly shootout, Eşref and Kadir rely on their own instincts and tactics to survive. Though Eşref manages to make it out alive, he is forced to take increasingly dangerous risks to rescue Hıdır from enemy hands. Kadir, on the other hand, sees the chaos as an opportunity, using the crisis to push his drug operation to the next level. Meanwhile, Nisan comes across an old childhood photograph that sends her into a deep reflection about her past. Her inability to remember the other people in the photo gives Dinçer a powerful advantage, while Nisan herself teeters on the brink of confronting painful truths buried deep in her subconscious. As Nisan faces this emotional reckoning, the only person who stands firmly by her side, offering strength and support through her darkest moments is Eşref.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: When Dinçer tries to manipulate Nisan for his own career purposes and keep her away from Eşref, Eşref's patience runs out and he confronts Dinçer. Although Kadir tries to control Tufan's reckless actions, Tufan jeopardizes Kadir's operation by taking dangerous steps. After an attack on their home, the Gürdal family pursues Tufan, but it's unclear who will be the one hunted in this chase.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: After Nisan chooses Dinçer, Eşref ends their relationship, leaving Nisan desperate to fix things. Seeking an informant, Eşref turns to Çiğdem, and when Nisan hears they are together, her anger erupts. Meanwhile, Kadir prepares to uphold his promise to İhtiyar, but Eşref’s latest move hits him hard, dragging Dinçer into danger as well. Learning that his secret admirer is alive, Eşref finds himself closer than ever to confronting Dinçer.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Nisan, whose suspicions were further strengthened by Fulya's death, continues her secret battle to uncover Dinçer's secret. Tufan, now in police custody, poses a threat to everyone. Kadir joins a cunning plan to intervene, but things are on the verge of spiraling out of control. While Eşref struggles to cope with the gnawing suspicion of betrayal, he must also stand firm against the treacherous slander that will be leveled against him.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Even though Eşref learns that Nisan is not an informant, he remains suspicious and continues to follow her. As Nisan searches for ways to resolve the deadly suspicion that has come between her and Eşref, she finds herself in far greater danger. Faruk, sent to prison for attacking Harun, puts the team in a whole new challenge. On top of all this, Eşref prepares to make a devastating move against Kadir's operation, both to protect Faruk and to clean up the streets.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Following their encounter, Nisan's abduction by the killer plunges Eşref into a major crisis.  Meanwhile, Kadir, whose affairs are going badly because of Eşref, takes a risky step to continue the operation. However, this move will cause him far more trouble than he expected. Nisan, facing death, is forced to confront the chilling truth about her brother's murder. The killer, who plans to use Nisan as leverage, is unaware that he will face Eşref's wrath.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: In the war that Kadir officially launched against him, the orphans are divided into two camps. Eşref tries to act cautiously towards Kadir, but when Sadık dies before his eyes, Eşref loses control. In his next encounter with Kadir, there will be no room for mercy. When Selma gets her hands on footage showing Eşref committing murder, she decides to use the situation to her advantage. Putting Nisan in a difficult position, Selma plans to use Nisan to uncover the roots of an organization far larger than Eşref. Nisan, willing to risk her life for the man she loves, will have a heated confrontation with Eşref as part of her plan.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Upon learning that his son is Kadir, Hıdır searches for ways to hide Kadir from Eşref, while waiting for the right moment for the big confrontation he has been waiting for all these years. After Nisan is shot, Dinçer takes his revenge plan to the next level, putting Nisan in a more dangerous situation than ever before. Although Eşref tries to save Nisan from this deadly game, Nisan's fate depends on a single step Eşref takes.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Nisan tries to find out who kidnapped her while also unraveling the mystery of the dark void in her past. Eşref's coronation ceremony creates a huge stir in the underworld. Kadir seeks ways to regain the power that has slipped from his grasp. However, learning that Hıdır is his father makes things even more complicated for Kadir. As Eşref continues his investigation into the person behind the name 'Fırat Koral', he will come face-to-face with the Old Man and be drawn into a difficult struggle with his team.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Just as he's mending his relationship with Nisan, the informant issue within the team resurfaces, causing tension between the two. Although Kadir resents Hıdır's support for Eşref, he confronts Hıdır again, reopening old wounds. Hıdır believes Kadir will clash with the Old Man for revenge, but Kadir has entirely different plans in mind. Caught in the middle of a psychological battle, Nisan seeks help from a psychiatrist to shed light on her dark past. But as the pieces fall into place, Nisan will face the most difficult test of her life.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Before confronting Eşref, she wants to be sure of what she's learned and sets out to uncover the traces of her past. Meanwhile, Eşref, guided by the Old Man, finds himself back in Burdur after many years, searching for Rüya. The treacherous attack against the orphans causes tension between Hıdır and Kadir. Kadir, who has begun to accept Hıdır as his father, will face a difficult choice that will test his conscience in order to prove himself to the Old Man and regain his power.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Eşref, who finally sees Rüya, whom he has waited for for years, closes his eyes to everything and confronts İhtiyar's men to protect her. Meanwhile, Nisan, who watches what is happening from inside, faces a major dilemma with Rüya's appearance and begins to question the memories he believed to be real. Torn between killing Hıdır or turning İhtiyar completely against him, Kadir decides to make critical moves to get out of this situation. However, even though he thinks he has everything under control, he does not realize that he will cause terrible destruction. Nisan fears that Rüya will harm his relationships, but Eşref is already preparing to turn all these events to his advantage.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: When Eşref realizes he's being played, he turns the situation to his advantage and takes control. However, Nisan, unaware of Eşref's plans, is deeply disappointed, believing he's fallen for Rüya. Following the treacherous attack on the orphans, Eşref confronts Kadir, and with Hıdır's involvement, he faces a shocking truth. Although he has lost trust in Hıdır, whom he considered his right-hand man, he sees Kadir's desperation as an opportunity to achieve his ultimate goal. Nisan learns the truth when she confronts the fake Rüya and this time becomes certain that she is Rüya.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Despite Nisan's efforts to protect Eşref, he is taken into custody. Meanwhile, Nisan's informant activities are revealed, shocking Eşref and the entire team. Although Nisan tries to defend herself, the audio recordings presented by Çiğdem make things considerably more difficult for her. Eşref falls into a deep silence in the face of the betrayal he has suffered. Taking advantage of Eşref's absence, the Old Man makes a shocking move that will change everything by bringing a new name to confront the Orphans.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Although Eşref is devastated when he learns that Nisan is an informant, he does everything he can to ensure her safety. Even though Nisan tells Eşref everything that happened to her, the betrayal leaves a wound in his heart. Surrounded by the police, Eşref finds himself at a critical crossroads and makes a move that shocks everyone.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Eşref, despite suffering immense pain due to his separation from Nisan, now knows that their love is impossible. Blaming himself for everything, Eşref struggles to cope with the anger building inside him and, despite himself, takes out his pain on those closest to him. While trying to deal with his grief on one side, Eşref steps into a fierce battle on the other, using all his power to sabotage Yaşar’s business. Nisan, determined to turn a new page in her life after everything that’s happened, wants to distance herself from everyone. But an unexpected encounter with Yaşar will drag Nisan into a surprising journey.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Eşref and Nisan's encounter at Yaşar's house leads to tension. When Eşref wants to question Nisan and Yaşar's bond, Nisan reminds him that they are no longer together and rejects his interference in her life. Although she now wants to stand on her own two feet without needing anyone's support, building a new life for herself will not be as easy as Nisan thinks. Eşref, on the other hand, has no intention of backing down in the power struggle he's engaged in with Yaşar. He is determined to play all his cards to emerge victorious in this race. However, at this moment, a surprise confession from Çiğdem will turn Eşref's world upside down.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Eşref, upon learning that Rüya, whom he has been searching for for years, has actually been Nisan all this time, immediately rushes to her side. Nisan, seeing Eşref gazing at her bedside in tears, is gripped by panic. Just as moments remain until Eşref reunites with his 'Dream,' Yaşar’s treacherous attack on the team throws all balances into disarray. With Yaşar’s final move delivering a deadly blow to Eşref and his team, the bloody war between them now takes on a deeply personal nature. Eşref resolves to take harsh measures to protect his loved ones. Meanwhile, upon learning she is pregnant, Nisan’s life will change completely.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview:
Nisan, shaken by the news of her pregnancy, begins to wonder how she will raise a child in the perilous life Ashraf is living.

She feels overwhelmed by the burden of making the right decision for herself and the child in her womb, caught in a dilemma.

In the conflict between Yasar and Ashraf, Kadir and Kenan turn the confusion into an opportunity and are eager to trade with Abbas. However, Ashraf has no intention of leaving the field to Kadir. Meanwhile, Gurdal searches everywhere for the culprit to quell the burning fire of revenge within him. Although he vowed to kill her, he will find the person he seeks in an unexpected place.

Ashraf manages to anticipate Yasar's plans and thwart them, maintaining the advantage. However, at the very moment Nisan is in danger, he will not realize that he has been lured into a trap this time.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Eşref escapes the deadly trap set by Yaşar by using the critical leverage he holds and turns the situation in his favor. Nisan, who is at the airport to leave the country, realizes through Eşref’s unexpected surprise that this love will not end. Investigating Eşref’s secret supporter, Yaşar manages to capture Balıkçı and uses chilling methods to make him talk. While Yaşar believes he has set a new trap, anticipating that Eşref will come to rescue Balıkçı, Eşref is in fact carrying out a much more complex plan behind the scenes.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Hearing that Eşref has had an accident, Nisan falls into great panic and mobilizes everyone. Although Eşref survives the crash, he enters a tough struggle to evade the men chasing him. This time, Yaşar targets one of Eşref’s most vulnerable points in order to obtain the information he holds. As Yaşar gets closer to the secret he is seeking, he will find the truth in a place he never expected. Gülümser’s sudden appearance confuses Nisan, who is already facing a difficult decision about her future with Eşref. After encountering Gülümser, Nisan learns that her past has been nothing but a lie. Eşref plays all his cards to reach İhtiyar. However, İhtiyar’s unexpected move forces Eşref to confront a truth that will shake him deeply.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Eşref proves that Gülümser is truly Nisan’s mother, but Nisan has great difficulty accepting this truth. The stress and pressure on her begin to affect Nisan’s pregnancy, so Eşref steps in to resolve everything at the root. Yaşar is willing to do anything to save his daughter from İhtiyar. Eşref promises that, in exchange for Yaşar’s testimony, he will deliver Elif safely to her father, but obtaining the information he expects will be more difficult than he imagines. When Balıkçı plans to reach İhtiyar through Nisan, Eşref looks for ways to stop this move. In the end, even while making plans for happiness with Nisan, he will realize that the peaceful life he dreamed of is not as close as it seemed.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Eşref and Gürdal are arrested after Yaşar’s death and find themselves in an entirely new struggle. In prison, Eşref enters a tough power confrontation with Celo Ağa, who tries to make him submit. On the outside, Nisan, shaken by Eşref’s absence, does everything she can to prove his innocence. In the process, the growing stress brings her pregnancy to a critical point. At the same time, Nisan, who is getting closer and closer to Gülümser, will come face to face with a shocking truth at a completely unexpected moment. Although it seems that Eşref is about to reach an agreement with Celo to maintain peace in the prison, the game he is playing will end up driving Celo out of his mind. While Eşref believes he has taken control, the move that Celo Ağa will make through his connections outside the prison will deliver a blow to the group like never before.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Devastated by Müslüm’s death, Eşref and his team swear revenge against those responsible for what happened. Overflowing with anger during the mourning process, Eşref becomes determined to put an end to Celo Ağa’s rule in prison. Meanwhile, Nisan, who learns that her father is one of the Elders, struggles to cope with this heavy truth, while Çiğdem’s schemes further upset the balance. When the team targets Muzo, who is responsible for Müslüm’s death, Nisan sets her own secret plan in motion to protect Eşref. As for Eşref, when he sparks a major prison riot, he is unaware that this move will turn everything into complete chaos.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Seeing Eşref, who was rescued from the prison fire at the last moment, Nisan realizes that she must put an end to this matter. In her agreement with the Fisherman, Nisan, who takes all the risks into account, states that she is ready to put herself on the line. To reach the Elder, however, she will have to join forces with people she never expected. Taking advantage of the fire to escape outside, Celo makes a deal with Kadir to settle his score with Eşref. Meanwhile, Eşref, who learns that Nisan has thrown herself into the fire, must find a way out of the deadlock he has fallen into.
